dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「音夢先輩は大丈夫なんですかねぇ」
dialogues.en: "I wonder how Nemu-sempai's doing."
dialogues.text: "I wonder how Nemu-sempai's doing."

dialogues.jp:
半ドンで、お｛てんとさま／天道様｝が真上にある時間に桜並木
を逆行する。
dialogues.en:
We walked back from school at noon, since the school got out
at lunch time.
dialogues.text:
We walked back from school at noon, since the school got out
at lunch time.

dialogues.jp:
ことりや眞子、杉並は用事があるらしく――と
言うか委員会や部活が忙しいらしい。
dialogues.en:
Kotori, Mako and Suginami all had something to do. I guess
they're busy with club activities and school committee.
dialogues.text:
Kotori, Mako and Suginami all had something to do. I guess
they're busy with club activities and school committee.

dialogues.jp:
そういえば、この時期になると部員や委員の勧
誘合戦が激しくなるからな。
dialogues.en:
I think clubs and the school committee recruit new members
around this time of the year.
dialogues.text:
I think clubs and the school committee recruit new members
around this time of the year.

dialogues.jp:
……杉並のやつは、なにをする気だか知らない
が。
dialogues.en: I don't know what Suginami's doing though......
dialogues.text: I don't know what Suginami's doing though......

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉先輩、聞いてますか？　音夢先輩の調子
　ですよぉ」
dialogues.en: "Are you listening? How's Nemu-sempai?"
dialogues.text: "Are you listening? How's Nemu-sempai?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ん……ああ。まぁまぁ、ってところだ」
dialogues.en: "So-so, I guess."
dialogues.text: "So-so, I guess."

dialogues.jp:
記憶が――俺との関係がなくなった時点から、
音夢の体調は一進一退といったところか。
dialogues.en:
Nemu's condition has been hanging in balance since she lost
her memory.
dialogues.text:
Nemu's condition has been hanging in balance since she lost
her memory.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「う〜ん、まぁまぁですかぁ」
dialogues.en: "So-so?"
dialogues.text: "So-so?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「お前、意外とこだわるな」
dialogues.en: "Why are you hanging up on that?"
dialogues.text: "Why are you hanging up on that?"

dialogues.jp: 首をかしげて美春を見下ろす。
dialogues.en: I looked down at Miharu as I tilted my head.
dialogues.text: I looked down at Miharu as I tilted my head.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「え？　なんでです、あったりまえじゃないで
　すかぁ！」
dialogues.en: "What? Why not? It's only natural."
dialogues.text: "What? Why not? It's only natural."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「本校の制服に身を包んだ、｛りり／凛々｝しい音夢先輩
　と一緒に仕事が出来ると思っていたのに！」
dialogues.en:
"I was hoping to work with Nemu-sempai in her new school
uniform and everything."
dialogues.text:
"I was hoping to work with Nemu-sempai in her new school
uniform and everything."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……はらはら」
dialogues.en: "Boohoo......"
dialogues.text: "Boohoo......"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「はいはい。そんな気になるなら、見舞いつい
　でに遊びに来るか？」
dialogues.en:
"I got it. Do you want to come see her since you're so
worried about her?"
dialogues.text:
"I got it. Do you want to come see her since you're so
worried about her?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「そんなっ、先輩方の愛の巣に行くなんて、と
　んでもめっそうもない！」
dialogues.en: "What? I can't go into your love nest!"
dialogues.text: "What? I can't go into your love nest!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あのなぁ……」
dialogues.en: "Come on......"
dialogues.text: "Come on......"

dialogues.jp: 思わず音夢みたいなジト目で｛にら／睨｝んでしまう。
dialogues.en: I had to stare at her just like how Nemu does.
dialogues.text: I had to stare at her just like how Nemu does.

dialogues.jp:
「んな、新婚家庭でもあるまいし……決めた。
　お前を連れて行く」
dialogues.en:
"It's not like visiting a newlywed. ...I've decided, I'm
going to take you home with me."
dialogues.text:
"It's not like visiting a newlywed. ...I've decided, I'm
going to take you home with me."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「うわっ！　ごーいんですねー♪」
dialogues.en: "Wow! You're very demanding."
dialogues.text: "Wow! You're very demanding."

dialogues.jp:
口調とは裏腹に、尻尾でも振りそうなくらい笑
顔で美春が歩調を軽くする。
dialogues.en:
Miharu smiled as if she'd be wagging her tail if she had
one. And Miharu walked lightly, despite what she said.
dialogues.text:
Miharu smiled as if she'd be wagging her tail if she had
one. And Miharu walked lightly, despite what she said.

dialogues.jp: 「わんこだ」
dialogues.en: "You're like a puppy."
dialogues.text: "You're like a puppy."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「はい？」
dialogues.en: "Excuse me?"
dialogues.text: "Excuse me?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「飼い主も喜ぶだろうさ」
dialogues.en: "Your mistress will be glad to see you."
dialogues.text: "Your mistress will be glad to see you."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「はいぃ？」
dialogues.en: "Excuse me?"
dialogues.text: "Excuse me?"

dialogues.jp:
音夢のための手土産をひきつれて、自宅への道
を穏やかな雲のように、ゆっくりと歩く。
dialogues.en:
We walked slowly like a calm cloud toward my home with a
surprise gift for Nemu.
dialogues.text:
We walked slowly like a calm cloud toward my home with a
surprise gift for Nemu.

dialogues.jp: 「ただいまぁ」
dialogues.en: "I'm home."
dialogues.text: "I'm home."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「おじゃましま〜す」
dialogues.en: "Hello."
dialogues.text: "Hello."

dialogues.jp:
ガサガサ、とみやげ物を購入した袋を鳴らしな
がら、美春が家に上がりこむ。
dialogues.en:
Miharu came into the house, bringing a plastic bag full of
presents she just bought for Nemu.
dialogues.text:
Miharu came into the house, bringing a plastic bag full of
presents she just bought for Nemu.

dialogues.jp: 中身は秘密兵器だと言っていたが……。
dialogues.en:
She said there's a secret weapon inside that plastic
bag......
dialogues.text:
She said there's a secret weapon inside that plastic
bag......

dialogues.jp: バナナだな……。
dialogues.en: I'm pretty sure it's a banana......
dialogues.text: I'm pretty sure it's a banana......

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「返事がないですね」
dialogues.en: "She isn't answering."
dialogues.text: "She isn't answering."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「上にいるんだろう」
dialogues.en: "She's probably upstairs."
dialogues.text: "She's probably upstairs."

dialogues.jp: がさがさ、と微かに２階から音がする。
dialogues.en: We heard some noise from upstairs.
dialogues.text: We heard some noise from upstairs.

dialogues.jp:
とりあえず飲み物でも用意しようと、まずは居
間を目指す。
dialogues.en:
I went into the living room to prepare something to drink
first.
dialogues.text:
I went into the living room to prepare something to drink
first.

dialogues.jp: 居間にもいない。
dialogues.en: She wasn't in the living room.
dialogues.text: She wasn't in the living room.

dialogues.jp: 「やっぱ、上だな」
dialogues.en: "Yep, she's upstairs."
dialogues.text: "Yep, she's upstairs."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.en: "Grrrr."
dialogues.text: "Grrrr."

dialogues.jp:
早く音夢に会いたいのを堪えられないというよ
うに、美春が落ち着きなく後に従う。
dialogues.en:
Miharu seems to be frustrated at not being able to go
upstairs right away, and she follows me around restlessly.
dialogues.text:
Miharu seems to be frustrated at not being able to go
upstairs right away, and she follows me around restlessly.

dialogues.jp: 「まぁ、待て」
dialogues.en: "Just calm down."
dialogues.text: "Just calm down."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉先輩……その、犬に話し掛けるみたいな
　口調に聞こえるのは、美春の耳がおかしいか
　らですか？」
dialogues.en:
"Asakura-sempai...... do you really talk to me like I was a
dog? Or is it my ears?"
dialogues.text:
"Asakura-sempai...... do you really talk to me like I was a
dog? Or is it my ears?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「いかんぞ、悲観的な考えは」
dialogues.en: "You shouldn't think so negatively."
dialogues.text: "You shouldn't think so negatively."

dialogues.jp: 冷蔵庫を開けてジュースをとりだす。
dialogues.en: I opened the refrigerator and took out a carton of juice.
dialogues.text: I opened the refrigerator and took out a carton of juice.

dialogues.jp:
音夢の昼飯用に作っておいたお粥とサラダが、
そのまま残っていたので一緒に取り出す。
dialogues.en:
I also took out the rice porridge and the salad I made for
Nemu. I made them for lunch so she doesn't have to cook for
herself, but they were still there.
dialogues.text:
I also took out the rice porridge and the salad I made for
Nemu. I made them for lunch so she doesn't have to cook for
herself, but they were still there.

dialogues.jp: とりあえず、このお粥は温めねばなるまい。
dialogues.en: I guess I should heat the rice porridge up for her.
dialogues.text: I guess I should heat the rice porridge up for her.

dialogues.jp: 「昼飯どうする？」
dialogues.en: "What do you want for lunch?"
dialogues.text: "What do you want for lunch?"

dialogues.jp:
どうせなので、ついでに自分用の食事を作るこ
とにした。
dialogues.en: I decided to fix lunch for myself at the same time.
dialogues.text: I decided to fix lunch for myself at the same time.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「もちろん、なにかあるなら頂きますよ！」
dialogues.en: "I'll take whatever you have!"
dialogues.text: "I'll take whatever you have!"

dialogues.jp: ソファーから身をのりだして美春が言う。
dialogues.en: Miharu said leaning forward on the sofa.
dialogues.text: Miharu said leaning forward on the sofa.

dialogues.jp:
「そうだな。美春は、お湯と電子レンジはどっ
　ちが好きだ？」
dialogues.en:
"I see. You have the choice between hot water and a
microwave. Which one would you like?"
dialogues.text:
"I see. You have the choice between hot water and a
microwave. Which one would you like?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……なかなかに難しい問題ですねぇ」
dialogues.en: "That sure is a difficult question......"
dialogues.text: "That sure is a difficult question......"

dialogues.jp: こめかみに指を当ててうめく。
dialogues.en: She moaned as she pressed the temple with her fingers.
dialogues.text: She moaned as she pressed the temple with her fingers.

dialogues.jp:
「手作りがいいなら、音夢が去年の夏に作った、
　謎の料理が冷凍されてるけど？」
dialogues.en:
"If you like homemade food, I have some unidentified food
Nemu made last summer in the freezer."
dialogues.text:
"If you like homemade food, I have some unidentified food
Nemu made last summer in the freezer."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「お見舞いのバナナを自分のために持って帰っ
　てもいいですか〜？」
dialogues.en: "Can I keep the bananas I bought for Nemu-sempai?"
dialogues.text: "Can I keep the bananas I bought for Nemu-sempai?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「分かった分かった。ラーメンとカレーとスパ
　ゲティのどれがいい？」
dialogues.en:
"Okay, fine. You have a choice of ramen, curry or
spaghetti."
dialogues.text:
"Okay, fine. You have a choice of ramen, curry or
spaghetti."

dialogues.jp: 戸棚の中を確認して三種の神器を示す。
dialogues.en:
I checked the cupboard and pointed at the most dependable
instant foods.
dialogues.text:
I checked the cupboard and pointed at the most dependable
instant foods.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ベタベタですね〜」
dialogues.en: "It's so cliche."
dialogues.text: "It's so cliche."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「バナナを入れられるのはカレーくらいか？」
dialogues.en: "Only thing you can put the banana in would be curry?"
dialogues.text: "Only thing you can put the banana in would be curry?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「バナナはなんにだって合いますよ♪」
dialogues.en: "Bananas go with anything."
dialogues.text: "Bananas go with anything."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……ラーメンの中に入れるのか？」
dialogues.en: "Can you put it in ramen?"
dialogues.text: "Can you put it in ramen?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「い〜れま〜すよ〜♪」
dialogues.en: "Of course!!"
dialogues.text: "Of course!!"

dialogues.jp:
こいつの家の食事風景は、南国か亜熱帯地方の
物なのかも知れない。
dialogues.en:
Maybe her family eats the same as people in the subtropical
zone.
dialogues.text:
Maybe her family eats the same as people in the subtropical
zone.

dialogues.jp:
見ていてこちらが苦痛を味わう羽目になりそう
なので、無難にカレーでいくことにする。
dialogues.en:
I decided on curry, because I think it'd hurt me to see her
put a banana into other food.
dialogues.text:
I decided on curry, because I think it'd hurt me to see her
put a banana into other food.

dialogues.jp:
レトルトのカレーを２袋お湯につっこみ、お粥
を器に移して電子レンジにいれた。
dialogues.en:
I put two curry pouches in the boiling water and transferred
the rice porridge into a bowl, then placed it in the
microwave.
dialogues.text:
I put two curry pouches in the boiling water and transferred
the rice porridge into a bowl, then placed it in the
microwave.

dialogues.jp: 「料理の超人」
dialogues.en: "Iron chef."
dialogues.text: "Iron chef."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……それは無茶だと思います」
dialogues.en: "You must be crazy......"
dialogues.text: "You must be crazy......"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉家３分クッキング」
dialogues.en: "The three minute cooking method by the Asakura family."
dialogues.text: "The three minute cooking method by the Asakura family."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「どこのご家庭でも３分じゃないですか？」
dialogues.en: "It's all the same for every family."
dialogues.text: "It's all the same for every family."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「う〜ん」
dialogues.en: "Well then......"
dialogues.text: "Well then......"

dialogues.jp: 器にご飯をよそりながら思い出す。
dialogues.en: And then, I remembered as I prepared the curry.
dialogues.text: And then, I remembered as I prepared the curry.

dialogues.jp:
「音夢は昔、レトルトカレーを２０分クッキン
　グしていたことがあったな」
dialogues.en:
"I just remembered Nemu cooked the instant curry for twenty
minutes before."
dialogues.text:
"I just remembered Nemu cooked the instant curry for twenty
minutes before."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「こう、板状に固形物になったカレーが出来て
　いた」
dialogues.en: "She made this solid curry that looked like a board."
dialogues.text: "She made this solid curry that looked like a board."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……それは、ルーですかね？」
dialogues.en: "Could it be the curry mix itself?"
dialogues.text: "Could it be the curry mix itself?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「あぁ、水で戻せたのかもな……バナナ貸せっ
　て、切っていれるから」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, then maybe we could have added water to it, and made
curry...... Here, give me the banana. I'll cut it for you."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, then maybe we could have added water to it, and made
curry...... Here, give me the banana. I'll cut it for you."

dialogues.jp:
なにげない話をしているうちに、カレーも出来
上がる。
dialogues.en: I made lunch as we talked.
dialogues.text: I made lunch as we talked.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ほいほい」
dialogues.en: "Here."
dialogues.text: "Here."

dialogues.jp: 美春からバナナを一房受け取る。
dialogues.en: Miharu gave me the banana.
dialogues.text: Miharu gave me the banana.

dialogues.jp: 「くっくっく、まな板の上のバナナ……」
dialogues.en: "A banana on an operating table......"
dialogues.text: "A banana on an operating table......"

dialogues.jp: 包丁に陽光を反射させて笑う。
dialogues.en: I smiled as I reflected the light from the kitchen knife.
dialogues.text: I smiled as I reflected the light from the kitchen knife.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「いいからバナナを切りましょうよ」
dialogues.en: "Okay, I got it."
dialogues.text: "Okay, I got it."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……しくしく」
dialogues.en: "Bwahahaha......"
dialogues.text: "Bwahahaha......"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「先輩楽しそうですね……」
dialogues.en: "You're having fun......"
dialogues.text: "You're having fun......"

dialogues.jp:
俺の横に並び、お湯の中から袋を取り出して美
春が微笑む。
dialogues.en:
Miharu smiled as she took out the curry pouch from the
boiling water as she stood next to me.
dialogues.text:
Miharu smiled as she took out the curry pouch from the
boiling water as she stood next to me.

dialogues.jp: 「そうか？」
dialogues.en: "You think?"
dialogues.text: "You think?"

dialogues.jp: バナナを美春用の皿にのせて包丁を水で洗う。
dialogues.en:
I put the cut banana on her plate and washed the kitchen
knife.
dialogues.text:
I put the cut banana on her plate and washed the kitchen
knife.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「学園に来だしたときは、なんだか浮かない顔
　していたけど……慣れましたか？」
dialogues.en:
"You looked depressed when you first came back to school,
but...... are you getting used to it now?"
dialogues.text:
"You looked depressed when you first came back to school,
but...... are you getting used to it now?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「まぁ……な」
dialogues.en: "I guess......"
dialogues.text: "I guess......"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「時折、ふっ、と表情がなくなるときがあるん
　ですよね」
dialogues.en: "Sometimes you space out."
dialogues.text: "Sometimes you space out."

dialogues.jp: てへ、と美春が眉をひそめる。
dialogues.en: Miharu frowned.
dialogues.text: Miharu frowned.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「音夢先輩のことを思っているんでしょうけど、
　一人で｛しょ／背負｝い込まないで下さいね」
dialogues.en:
"I'm sure you're thinking about Nemu-sempai, but don't take
it too personally."
dialogues.text:
"I'm sure you're thinking about Nemu-sempai, but don't take
it too personally."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「美春だって頼りないけど、朝倉先輩や音夢先
　輩の友達なんですから」
dialogues.en:
"I may not be much of a help, but I'm a friend of both of
you."
dialogues.text:
"I may not be much of a help, but I'm a friend of both of
you."

dialogues.jp: 相変わらず、人知れず｛さと／聡｝い奴だ。
dialogues.en: Surprisingly, she could be so sharp sometimes.
dialogues.text: Surprisingly, she could be so sharp sometimes.

dialogues.jp: 「……さて、音夢とご飯でも食べよう」
dialogues.en: "Well then, let's eat with Nemu."
dialogues.text: "Well then, let's eat with Nemu."

dialogues.jp: 全ての料理を盆にのせて、上を示す。
dialogues.en: I put everything on a tray, and pointed upstairs.
dialogues.text: I put everything on a tray, and pointed upstairs.

dialogues.jp: 「まぁ、頼りにしていないわけじゃない」
dialogues.en: "I'm not avoiding your help."
dialogues.text: "I'm not avoiding your help."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: 廊下に出て呟く。
dialogues.en: I mumbled as we walked out to the hallway.
dialogues.text: I mumbled as we walked out to the hallway.

dialogues.jp:
「俺は美春を頼りないなんて思ったことはない。
　多分だが」
dialogues.en: "I suppose I've never thought of you as much of a help."
dialogues.text: "I suppose I've never thought of you as much of a help."

dialogues.jp: 背中にいるはずの美春に呟く。
dialogues.en: I mumbled to Miharu who stood behind me.
dialogues.text: I mumbled to Miharu who stood behind me.

dialogues.jp:
「今日だって、音夢のやつも他の誰よりもお前
　が来てくれたのを喜ぶだろうし」
dialogues.en: "She'll be so happy to see you today."
dialogues.text: "She'll be so happy to see you today."

dialogues.jp: 「お前のドジな話を聞かされれば笑うだろうし」
dialogues.en: "She'll laugh hearing your goofy stories."
dialogues.text: "She'll laugh hearing your goofy stories."

dialogues.jp:
それは――音夢が笑ってくれるのなら、俺も嬉
しい。
dialogues.en: And when she laughs, it makes me happy too.
dialogues.text: And when she laughs, it makes me happy too.

dialogues.jp: 「だから、いつでも遊びに来いって」
dialogues.en: "So, come over anytime."
dialogues.text: "So, come over anytime."

dialogues.jp:
いまいち、俺の言っていることを理解していな
さそうな美春のため息。
dialogues.en:
Miharu sighed and it sounded like she didn't understand what
I was saying.
dialogues.text:
Miharu sighed and it sounded like she didn't understand what
I was saying.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……いったい何が言いたいんです？」
dialogues.en: "What do you want to say?"
dialogues.text: "What do you want to say?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「……何で俺達の周りには、こんなにお節介す
　ぎる奴が多いんだろうなって言ったんだよ」

呟きは苦笑を｛にじ／滲｝ませて、心をほんのりと温かく
させた。
dialogues.en: "I'm too lazy to explain it to you."
dialogues.text: "I'm too lazy to explain it to you."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「はい？」
dialogues.en: "Mm? What? What?"
dialogues.text: "Mm? What? What?"

dialogues.jp: 小首を傾げている美春に、笑みが深まる。
dialogues.en: I'm expecting your natural foolishness.
dialogues.text: I'm expecting your natural foolishness.

dialogues.jp:
「……なぁ、美春。音夢のやつを驚かせてみる
　か？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, do you want to play a trick on Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, do you want to play a trick on Nemu?"

dialogues.jp: 階段の前で声を殺す。
dialogues.en: I whispered in front of the stairs.
dialogues.text: I whispered in front of the stairs.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「どうやってですか？」
dialogues.en: "How?"
dialogues.text: "How?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「お前が来てることなんて知らないだろうから、
　俺と一緒に今から家に行くと電話しろ」
dialogues.en:
"She doesn't know you're here. Call her now and tell her
you're coming to visit with me."
dialogues.text:
"She doesn't know you're here. Call her now and tell her
you're coming to visit with me."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「あぁ、それで、切ってすぐにドバババ〜ン、
　と部屋に入るわけですね」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, and I go into the room right after I hang up the phone
with her?"
dialogues.text:
"Oh, and I go into the room right after I hang up the phone
with her?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「相変わらず発想が子供じみてますね」
dialogues.en: "Such a childish idea as usual."
dialogues.text: "Such a childish idea as usual."

dialogues.jp:
さっきの逆襲を受けた気がしたが、この際流す
ことにするか。
dialogues.en: I think she paid me back, but I decided to let it go.
dialogues.text: I think she paid me back, but I decided to let it go.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「てへへへへ」
dialogues.en: "Teehee!"
dialogues.text: "Teehee!"

dialogues.jp: 電話を取り出して美春が忍び笑う。
dialogues.en: Miharu took out her cell phone and smiled.
dialogues.text: Miharu took out her cell phone and smiled.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「あ、音夢先輩ですかぁ。美春ですけど、寝て
　いませんでしたか？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Nemu-sempai? It's Miharu. Were you asleep?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Nemu-sempai? It's Miharu. Were you asleep?"

dialogues.jp:
上に聞こえないかヒヤヒヤしたが、本当に音夢
を気遣う美春の声は小さい。
dialogues.en:
It worried me that Nemu might hear us, but Miharu's voice
was really quiet.
dialogues.text:
It worried me that Nemu might hear us, but Miharu's voice
was really quiet.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「はい……はい、委員会のほうは大丈夫です。
　だから音夢先輩は心配しないで身体を休めて
　ください」
dialogues.en:
"Yes...... yes. Everything at the school committee's going
well. Don't you worry about a thing and just get better."
dialogues.text:
"Yes...... yes. Everything at the school committee's going
well. Don't you worry about a thing and just get better."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「ど〜んと美春に任せて……って、え？　それ
　が心配？」
dialogues.en:
"Just let me handle it...... What? You're even more
worried?"
dialogues.text:
"Just let me handle it...... What? You're even more
worried?"

dialogues.jp: 同じこと言われている。
dialogues.en: She's saying the same thing.
dialogues.text: She's saying the same thing.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「あ、まぁ、朝倉先輩と一緒に遊びに行きます
　から」
dialogues.en: "Well, anyway, I'm coming to visit with Asakura-sempai."
dialogues.text: "Well, anyway, I'm coming to visit with Asakura-sempai."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「ぅえ？　……お土産にバナナは買ってこなく
　ていい？」
dialogues.en: "What? You don't need bananas?"
dialogues.text: "What? You don't need bananas?"

dialogues.jp: バナナ……。
dialogues.en: Bananas......
dialogues.text: Bananas......

dialogues.jp: 見事なまでの後輩っぷり。
dialogues.en: She knows everything about Miharu.
dialogues.text: She knows everything about Miharu.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あ……ははははは……え？」
dialogues.en: "Hahaha...... What?"
dialogues.text: "Hahaha...... What?"

dialogues.jp: ふと、美春が真剣な表情で眉をひそめる。
dialogues.en: Miharu frowned with a serious look on her face.
dialogues.text: Miharu frowned with a serious look on her face.

dialogues.jp: 美春が俺を見上げる。
dialogues.en: Miharu looked at me.
dialogues.text: Miharu looked at me.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「はい……あはははは、楽しいですよ。だから、
　音夢先輩も早く行きましょうね」
dialogues.en:
"Yes...... Sure, it's fun. So, you need to come back to
school soon."
dialogues.text:
"Yes...... Sure, it's fun. So, you need to come back to
school soon."

dialogues.jp: 『学園は楽しい？』
dialogues.en: "Is school fun?"
dialogues.text: "Is school fun?"

dialogues.jp: 多分、そんなことを聞いたのだ。
dialogues.en: I think she asked something like that.
dialogues.text: I think she asked something like that.

dialogues.jp: あいつ……。
dialogues.en: Nemu......
dialogues.text: Nemu......

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「はい……それじゃあ、また後でです！」
dialogues.en: "Yes...... Then, I'll see you later!"
dialogues.text: "Yes...... Then, I'll see you later!"

dialogues.jp: 最後に景気をつけて、美春が電話を切る。
dialogues.en: Miharu hang up the phone as she acted happy.
dialogues.text: Miharu hang up the phone as she acted happy.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「あの……朝倉先輩に余計なことは言わないよ
　うに、って」
dialogues.en: "Well...... she told me to not to tell you."
dialogues.text: "Well...... she told me to not to tell you."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……飯が冷めちまうぞ」
dialogues.en: "Come on, it's getting cold."
dialogues.text: "Come on, it's getting cold."

dialogues.jp: 階段に足を踏み出して言う。
dialogues.en: I said as I stepped on the stairs.
dialogues.text: I said as I stepped on the stairs.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あはははは、はいです！」
dialogues.en: "Okay, sure!"
dialogues.text: "Okay, sure!"

dialogues.jp: お互いに分かっている。
dialogues.en: We both understand.
dialogues.text: We both understand.

dialogues.jp: ふたりとも音夢を笑わせに行くのだ。
dialogues.en: We're going to make Nemu laugh.
dialogues.text: We're going to make Nemu laugh.

dialogues.jp: だから、暗い話題を持ち出してはいけない。
dialogues.en: So, we can't talk about anything negative.
dialogues.text: So, we can't talk about anything negative.

dialogues.jp:
「せーのだぞ、２階にあがったらすぐに部屋に
　突撃だ」
dialogues.en:
"Are you ready? We'll jump into the room as soon as we get
there."
dialogues.text:
"Are you ready? We'll jump into the room as soon as we get
there."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「了解です」
dialogues.en: "I got it."
dialogues.text: "I got it."

dialogues.jp: 一段一段。
dialogues.en: Step by step.
dialogues.text: Step by step.

dialogues.jp: 「静かにな」
dialogues.en: "Be quiet."
dialogues.text: "Be quiet."

dialogues.jp: ゆっくりと階段を上る。
dialogues.en: We went upstairs slowly.
dialogues.text: We went upstairs slowly.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「はいな」
dialogues.en: "I know."
dialogues.text: "I know."

dialogues.jp: 一段。
dialogues.en: One step at a time.
dialogues.text: One step at a time.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「げほっ、げほげほ……っ！」
dialogues.en: "Cough, cough!"
dialogues.text: "Cough, cough!"

dialogues.jp: 階段を――。
dialogues.en: Up the stairs......
dialogues.text: Up the stairs......

dialogues.jp: どん、と背中に美春がぶつかる。
dialogues.en: Miharu bumped into me.
dialogues.text: Miharu bumped into me.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「げほっ、げほげほ……っ！」
dialogues.en: "Cough, cough......!"
dialogues.text: "Cough, cough......!"

dialogues.jp: ◆美春と悪戯◆
dialogues.en: ◆Playing a trick on Nemu with Miharu◆
dialogues.text: ◆Playing a trick on Nemu with Miharu◆

dialogues.jp:
何気なさが戻ってきているある日。美春が音夢
のお見舞いでに家に遊びに来ることになった。
dialogues.en:
I went back to the usual routine and Miharu decided to visit
Nemu at home.
dialogues.text:
I went back to the usual routine and Miharu decided to visit
Nemu at home.

dialogues.jp:
ふと、電話をかけてすぐに音夢の部屋に飛び込
むという、ちょっとした悪戯を思いつく。
dialogues.en:
I thought about playing a trick on Nemu. So Miharu called
Nemu first, and then we were going to jump into her room
after hanging up the phone with Nemu to surprise her.
dialogues.text:
I thought about playing a trick on Nemu. So Miharu called
Nemu first, and then we were going to jump into her room
after hanging up the phone with Nemu to surprise her.

dialogues.jp:
音夢への電話も終わり、後は部屋に入ろうとう
ところで、ひどく咳き込む音が響いてきた……。
dialogues.en:
Miharu hang up the phone with her, and as we were going to
jump into the room, we heard Nemu coughing really hard......
dialogues.text:
Miharu hang up the phone with her, and as we were going to
jump into the room, we heard Nemu coughing really hard......
